source: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991–2020 (annual/seasonal, by station); U.S. Census Bureau 2024 ZCTA Gazetteer

fields.last50: date with a 50% chance of a 32°F freeze on or after it (median last spring frost)
fields.last10: date with a 10% chance of a 32°F freeze on or after it
fields.first50: date with a 50% chance of a 32°F freeze on or before it (median first fall frost)
fields.first10: date with a 10% chance of a 32°F freeze on or before it
fields.special: "rare" = freezes too infrequent to compute (frost-free in most years); "all" = freeze possible in any month
